name: PipelinePackerInstaller
description: Find in cache or download a specific version of Packer and prepend it to the PATH
author: sethbacon

inputs.name: packerVersion
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: The version of Packer to install. Use 'latest' to install the current latest release.

inputs.name: downloadSource
inputs.label: Download source
inputs.helpMarkDown: Where to download the Packer binary from.

inputs.name: registryUrl
inputs.label: Registry base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of your terraform-registry-backend instance. Must use HTTPS. Example: https://registry.example.com

inputs.name: registryMirrorName
inputs.label: Mirror configuration name
inputs.helpMarkDown: The mirror configuration name in your registry backend. This is the {name} path segment in /terraform/binaries/{name}/...

inputs.name: registryAllowedHosts
inputs.label: Allowed registry download hosts
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional comma- or newline-separated allowlist of the storage hosts the registry may hand the binary download off to. A `*.` prefix matches subdomains only (e.g. `*.s3.amazonaws.com`). The allowlist is enforced on the initial download URL and re-checked on every redirect hop. When empty (default), the registry may name any public host, but a host that is — or resolves to — a loopback, link-local/metadata (169.254.0.0/16), carrier-grade-NAT, or RFC1918/ULA private address is refused; set this to pin a registry that legitimately serves from a private or air-gapped storage host.

inputs.name: mirrorBaseUrl
inputs.label: Mirror base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of your binary mirror. Must use HTTPS. Must serve files at the same path structure as releases.hashicorp.com/packer. Example: https://artifacts.example.com/hashicorp/packer

inputs.name: mirrorAllowedHosts
inputs.label: Allowed mirror hosts
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional comma- or newline-separated host allowlist for private or air-gapped mirrors. A `*.` prefix matches subdomains only. The allowlist is enforced on the initial download URL and re-checked on every redirect hop. When empty (default), a host that is — or resolves to — a loopback, link-local/metadata (169.254.0.0/16), carrier-grade-NAT, or RFC1918/ULA private address is refused, on the initial URL and on every redirect hop alike. Addresses are classified numerically, so short-form/decimal/octal/hex IPv4 and IPv4-mapped IPv6 spellings are covered. Note that the default-deny check resolves DNS at check time and does not pin the resulting address into the connection, so it is defense-in-depth against a host that statically points at a private address rather than a complete defense against active DNS rebinding.

inputs.name: requireGpgSignature
inputs.label: Require GPG signature verification
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, fail if the GPG signature file is unavailable. Defaults to true for HashiCorp downloads. Disable for mirrors that do not serve .sig files.

inputs.name: requireChecksum
inputs.label: Require checksum verification
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled (default), fail if the mirror or registry does not provide a SHA256 checksum for the requested version. Disable only if your mirror/registry cannot publish checksums and you trust it to verify server-side.

inputs.name: requireOnlineReverification
inputs.label: Fail closed if an unmarked cache entry cannot be re-verified online
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, a tool-cache hit that has no usable local integrity hash and requires online re-verification (requireChecksum=true) FAILS the task if the configured source cannot be reached to re-verify, instead of degrading to a warning and using the unverified cached binary. Default (false) preserves the availability-first behavior that keeps offline/air-gapped cache reuse working. Enable on shared persistent self-hosted agents where you prefer an availability loss over trusting a cache entry an earlier job may have populated without verification. Has no effect when requireChecksum is false (re-verification is skipped) or on a cache entry that already carries a well-formed integrity hash (verified locally, offline).

inputs.name: forceOnlineReverification
inputs.label: Always re-verify a cache hit online, even when its local integrity hash is valid
inputs.helpMarkDown: requireOnlineReverification (above) only governs a cache entry that has NO usable local integrity hash. This input covers the entry it does not: the local hash sidecar lives in the same tool-cache directory as the binary it protects, so it cannot distinguish a genuinely untampered cache from one where both the binary and its sidecar were rewritten together by the same agent-account write access. When enabled, every cache hit is re-downloaded and re-verified against the configured source and compared byte-for-byte to the cached copy, regardless of whether the local hash matches. Default (false) trusts a matching hash without a network round-trip, which is the intended performance benefit of caching at all. Enable on agents where that co-located hash is not an acceptable trust boundary on its own. Has no effect when requireChecksum is false (re-verification is skipped entirely).

outputVariables.name: packerLocation
outputVariables.description: The location of the packer binary that was installed on the agent.

outputVariables.name: packerDownloadedFrom
outputVariables.description: The source from which packer was downloaded: 'hashicorp', 'registry:<url>', 'mirror:<url>', or 'cache'.

messages.InputVersionNotValidSemanticVersion: Input version %s is not a valid semantic version
messages.PackerNotFoundInFolder: Packer executable not found in path %s
messages.PackerDownloadFailed: Failed to download Packer from url %s. Error: %s
messages.PackerVersionNotFound: Unable to resolve the latest Packer version from the HashiCorp checkpoint API. Pin an explicit 'packerVersion' instead of 'latest', or retry — refusing to silently fall back to a stale pinned version.
messages.InsecureUrlRejected: Insecure URL rejected: %s. Only HTTPS URLs are allowed.
messages.MirrorDownloadHostIsPrivate: Mirror download host %s is private or link-local and was rejected. Configure mirrorAllowedHosts to explicitly allow a trusted private mirror.
messages.MirrorDownloadHostNotAllowed: Mirror download host %s is not in mirrorAllowedHosts (%s).
messages.RegistryDownloadHostIsPrivate: Registry download host %s is private or link-local and was rejected. Configure registryAllowedHosts to explicitly allow a trusted private storage host.
messages.RegistryDownloadHostNotAllowed: Registry download host %s is not in registryAllowedHosts (%s).
messages.RegistryTrustAnchorIsChecksumOnly: Installed from the private registry (%s). Integrity rests on the SHA256 the registry itself asserts, delivered over the same TLS session as the archive -- no signature is verified on this path. The hashicorp and mirror sources verify SHA256SUMS against the pinned HashiCorp GPG key; requireGpgSignature does not apply to downloadSource=registry. A compromised or misconfigured registry can serve a modified archive whose recorded hash matches it. Use downloadSource hashicorp, or a mirror that publishes a signed SHA256SUMS, if you need signature-anchored trust.
messages.RegistryRequestFailed: Registry request failed for %s. HTTP status: %s
messages.ResolvingLatestFromRegistry: Resolving latest Packer version from registry: %s
messages.ReverifyingCachedTool: Cache hit for %s has no usable stored integrity hash (cached before re-verification existed, cached with checksum verification disabled, or the recorded hash is malformed). Re-downloading the release to re-verify the cached executable; set requireChecksum to false to skip this.
messages.ForcingOnlineReverification: Cache hit for %s has a valid local integrity hash, but forceOnlineReverification is enabled. Re-downloading the release to re-verify online rather than trusting the recorded hash; set requireChecksum to false to skip this.
messages.CachedToolReverified: Cached %s re-verified against the freshly downloaded, verified release; integrity hash recorded for future cache hits.
messages.CachedToolReverificationMismatch: Cached %s does not match the freshly downloaded, verified release (verified: %s, cached: %s). The cached copy was either never verified or has been altered since caching; clear the agent's tool cache for this version and re-run.
messages.CachedToolReverificationUnavailable: Could not re-verify cached %s: %s. Proceeding with the cached executable — expected for offline/air-gapped agents; set requireChecksum to false to skip the attempt and silence this warning.
messages.CachedToolReverificationSourceUnreachabl: Could not re-verify cached %s: %s. requireOnlineReverification is enabled, so the task fails closed rather than trusting an unverified cache entry. Ensure the configured source is reachable, or disable requireOnlineReverification to fall back to using the cached executable with a warning.
